Header Command Bar */}\n      <header className=\"flex h-16 shrink-0 items-center justify-between border-b border-border bg-surface px-6\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-8\">\n           <SummaryMetric label=\"TOTAL BUDGET\" value={formatCurrency(trip?.budget ?? 0)} />\n           <div className=\"h-8 w-px bg-border/50\" />\n           <SummaryMetric label=\"ACTUAL SPEND\" value={formatCurrency(actualTotal)} />\n           <div className=\"h-8 w-px bg-border/50\" />\n           <SummaryMetric label=\"REMAINING\" value={formatCurrency(remaining)} tone={remaining >= 0 ? \"positive\" : \"negative\"} />\n        </div>\n        \n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n           <button \n              onClick={exportCsv}\n              className=\"flex h-8 items-center gap-2 rounded-md border border-border bg-background px-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted hover:text-black transition-all\"\n           >\n              <Download size={12} /> Export CSV\n           </button>\n           <button className=\"flex h-8 items-center gap-2 rounded-md bg-black px-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-all\">\n              <PlusCircle size={12} /> New Expense\n           </button>\n        </div>\n      </header>\n\n      {/* 2. Main Table Area */}\n      <main className=\"flex-1 overflow-y-auto\">\n        <table className=\"w-full border-collapse text-left\">\n           <thead>\n              <tr className=\"sticky top-0 z-10 border-b border-border bg-surface text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted\">\n                 <th className=\"px-6 py-3 font-black\">Category</th>\n                 <th className=\"px-6 py-3 font-black text-right\">Estimated</th>\n                 <th className=\"px-6 py-3 font-black text-right\">Actual</th>\n                 <th className=\"px-6 py-3 font-black text-right\">Difference</th>\n                 <th className=\"px-6 py-3 font-black\">Utilization</th>\n                 <th className=\"w-12 px-6 py-3\"></th>\n              </tr>\n           </thead>\n           <tbody className=\"divide-y divide-border/40\">\n              {categories.map((cat) => {\n                const diff = cat.estimated - cat.actual;\n                const util = cat.estimated > 0 ? (cat.actual / cat.estimated) * 100 : 0;\n                return (\n                  <tr key={cat.name} className=\"group hover:bg-surface/50 transition-colors\">\n                     <td className=\"px-6 py-4\">\n                        <span className=\"text-xs font-bold text-foreground\">{cat.name}</span>\n                     </td>\n                     <td className=\"px-6 py-4 text-right\">\n                        <span className=\"text-xs font-medium text-muted\">{formatCurrency(cat.estimated)}</span>\n                     </td>\n                     <td className=\"px-6 py-4 text-right\">\n                        <span className=\"text-xs font-bold text-foreground\">{formatCurrency(cat.actual)}</span>\n                     </td>\n                     <td className=\"px-6 py-4 text-right\">\n                        <span className={cn(\n                          \"text-xs font-bold\",\n                          diff >= 0 ? \"text-emerald-600\" : \"text-rose-600\"\n                        )}>\n                          {diff > 0 ? \"+\" : \"\"}{formatCurrency(diff)}\n                        </span>\n                     </td>\n                     <td className=\"px-6 py-4\">\n                        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n                           <div className=\"h-1.5 w-24 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-surface-2 border border-border\">\n                              <div \n                                 className={cn(\n                                   \"h-full transition-all duration-700\",\n                                   util > 100 ? \"bg-rose-500\" : util > 80 ? \"bg-amber-500\" : \"bg-black\"\n                                 )}\n                                 style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, util)}%` }}\n                              />\n                           </div>\n                           <span className=\"text-[10px] font-bold text-muted w-8\">{Math.round(util)}%</span>\n                        </div>\n                     </td>\n                     <td className=\"px-6 py-4 text-right\">\n                        <button className=\"opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 p-1 hover:text-foreground transition-all\">\n                           <MoreHorizontal size={14} />\n                        </button>\n                     </td>\n                  </tr>\n                );\n              })}\n           </tbody>\n        </table>\n      </main>\n\n      {/* 3. Bottom Information Rail */}\n      <footer className=\"flex h-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-between border-t border-border bg-surface px-6 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-muted\">\n         <div className=\"flex items-center gap-6\">\n            <span className=\"flex items-center gap-2\"><Search size={12} /> {eurRate.source.provider}</span>\n            <span className=\"text-foreground\">1 USD = {eurRate.rate.toFixed(3)} EUR</span>\n            <div className=\"h-4 w-px bg-border\" />\n            <span className=\"flex items-center gap-2\"><ShieldCheck size={12} className=\"text-emerald-500\" /> Compliance Active</span>\n         </div>\n         <div className=\"flex items-center gap-4\">\n            <span className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5\"><ArrowUpRight size={12} className={cn(remaining >= 0 ? \"text-emerald-500\" : \"text-rose-500\")} /> {remaining >= 0 ? \"Under total budget\" : \"Budget threshold exceeded\"}</span>\n            <div className=\"h-4 w-px bg-border\" />\n            <span className=\"text-foreground\">Press CMD+K for shortcuts</span>\n         </div>\n      </footer>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction SummaryMetric({ label, value, tone = \"neutral\" }: { label: string; value: string; tone?: \"neutral\" | \"positive\" | \"negative\" }) {\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-1\">\n       <span className=\"text-[9px] font-black tracking-widest text-muted\">{label}</span>\n       <span className={cn(\n         \"text-xl font-bold tracking-tight\",\n         tone === \"positive\" ? \"text-emerald-600\" : tone === \"negative\" ? \"text-rose-600\" : \"text-foreground\"\n       )}>\n         {value}\n       </span>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
```json
  }
}
```

## MODEL ✨

start_topic: Architectural Export & Code Dump (V2 High-Density System)

I have performed a comprehensive architectural breakdown of the **V2 High-Density System**. This project is a world-class travel planning workspace built on a **viewport-locked (100vh), zero-scroll architecture** inspired by professional tools like Linear and Stripe.

### 1. Repository Structure & Boundaries

The project strictly separates concerns between the Next.js App Router (UI & Routing), Prisma (Data Persistence), and custom AI/API services.

```text
/
├── prisma/                 # [DATA LAYER]
│   └── schema.prisma       # SQLite models: Trip, ItineraryDay, SavedPlace, Booking, etc.
├── src/
│   ├── app/                # [NEXT.JS ROUTING & BACKEND]
│   │   ├── api/            # API Endpoints (Itinerary Generation, Maps, Weather)
│   │   ├── actions.ts      # Main Server Actions (CRUD for Trips, Bookings, Profile)
│   │   ├── layout.tsx      # Root Entry with Global CSS
│   │   └── itinerary/      # Workspaces (Discover, Budget, Today, etc.)
│   ├── components/         # [FRONTEND V2 UI]
│   │   └── travel/         # High-Density Workspaces (Split-panes, Map Stages)
│   └── lib/                # [LOGIC & UTILITIES]
│       ├── ai/             # OpenAI Prompt Engineering (Itinerary & Summary Logic)
│       ├── api/            # External Integrations (Google Maps, Open-Meteo, Gmail)
│       └── db/             # Prisma Client & DB Helper functions
```

### 2. Core Technologies & Stack

*   **UI Framework:** Next.js 15 (App Router)
*   **Styling:** Tailwind CSS 4.0 (Custom high-density theme)
*   **Visuals:** Framer Motion (State-aware micro-animations)
*   **Tactile Layer:** CSS SVG Noise (Multi-layered fibrous paper texture)
*   **Data:** Prisma ORM with SQLite
*   **Intelligence:** OpenAI API (GPT-5.5 / GPT-4o)
*   **Telemetry:** Google Routes API, Open-Meteo, Frankfurter FX

---

### 3. Critical Source Code Dump

The following consolidated code blocks represent the "brain" and "skeleton" of the redesigned V2 system.

#### 🏗️ The Data Brain
// prisma/schema.prisma
```prisma
model Trip {
  id                  String             @id @default(cuid())
  name                String
  destination         String?
  startDate           DateTime
  endDate             DateTime
  budget              Float
  travelStyle         String
  status              String             @default("planning")
  itineraryDays       ItineraryDay[]
  savedPlaces         SavedPlace[]
  budgetCategories    BudgetCategory[]
}

model ItineraryDay {
  id               String          @id @default(cuid())
  date             DateTime
  theme            String
  morningPlan      String
  afternoonPlan    String
  eveningPlan      String
  estimatedCost    Float           @default(0)
  placesIncluded   String?         // Stored as JSON string for AI portability
}
```

#### ⚙️ The Backend Execution (Server Actions)
// src/app/actions.ts
```typescript
"use server";

import { prisma } from "@/lib/db/prisma";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

export async function createTrip(formData: FormData) {
  // Fixed multi-step persistence bug via DOM preservation
  const trip = await prisma.trip.create({
    data: {
      name: String(formData.get("name")),
      destination: String(formData.get("destination")),
      startDate: new Date(String(formData.get("startDate"))),
      endDate: new Date(String(formData.get("endDate"))),
      budget: Number(formData.get("budget")),
      travelStyle: String(formData.get("travelStyle")),
    },
  });
  revalidatePath("/");
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import { InteractiveMap } from "@/components/travel/interactive-map";

export function ItineraryWorkspace({ initialDays, selectedPlaces }) {
  const [showDetail, setShowDetail] = useState(true);

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full w-full overflow-hidden flex-row">
      {/* 1. Timeline Rail (350px) */}
      <aside className="w-[350px] shrink-0 border-r border-border bg-surface overflow-y-auto">
         {/* Render high-density vertical timeline items */}
      </aside>

      {/* 2. Map Stage (Responsive Flex) */}
      <main className="relative flex-1 bg-surface-2 flex flex-row">
        <div className="flex-1 relative overflow-hidden">
           <InteractiveMap pins={selectedPlaces} />
        </div>

        {/* 3. Retractable detail pane (400px) */}
        <div className={cn("relative border-l transition-all", showDetail ? "w-[400px]" : "w-0")}>
           <button onClick={() => setShowDetail(!showDetail)} className="absolute -left-8 top-1/2" />
           <AnimatePresence>
              {showDetail && <DayEditor />}
           </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
```
